## ERROR TIPS

### Errors When Attempting to Place Entities Without Inventory
- Ensure you have the required entity in your inventory before attempting to place it.

### Errors When Inserting Items into Machines
- Make sure you have the necessary items in your inventory before trying to insert them into machines.
- Verify that the target machine can accept the item type you are trying to insert.

### Errors When Crafting Items Without Required Ingredients
- Check if all sub-ingredients required for crafting an item are available in sufficient quantities.
- Ensure that the necessary crafting or smelting facilities are operational and supplied with the correct ingredients.

### Repeated Harvesting Attempts Without Inventory Updates
- Avoid repeated harvesting attempts from the same location without checking inventory updates to prevent redundant actions.

### Insufficient Resources for Crafting
- Before initiating a craft, confirm that all prerequisite resources are available either in your inventory or being actively produced by existing structures.
